description: This Java class `ModifyPolicyEntryResponse` represents the response to a `ModifyPolicyEntry` command within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It handles serialization/deserialization to/from JSON, manages the policy ID, label, and created policy entry information, and includes factory methods for response creation with different statuses.

classes.name: ModifyPolicyEntryResponse
classes.description: A response class representing the outcome of modifying a policy entry, capable of being created from JSON, and providing information such as policy ID, labels, created entry, and response status.

methods.name: created
methods.description: Factory method to create a response with HTTP 201 (Created) status, given policy ID, optional policy entry, and headers.

methods.name: modified
methods.description: Factory method to create a response with HTTP 204 (No Content) status, for modifications, with options to specify label.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string or object into a `ModifyPolicyEntryResponse` instance.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the policy ID associated with this response.

methods.name: getPolicyEntryCreated
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the created PolicyEntry.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Retrieves the PolicyEntry as JSON if available.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Constructs and returns the JSON pointer path for the resource, based on its label.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends payload data to the JSON object builder, including policy ID, label, and policy entry if present.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new response with updated DittoHeaders.
